_help: Rows on the home page (PLAN.md 4.10). layout: "rows" (niche rows) or "grid" (the previous featured Reel + grid, built exactly as before); the hourly sync rebuilds the site when this file or i18n/*.json changes. rows: the order on the page; titles live in i18n/<lang>.json rows.titles.<key>. A row with top: N is the N most-watched Reels and is the only row a Reel can share with another. about: what the niche means, for the Gemini classifier. keywords: the fallback when Gemini is unavailable, matched in row order against the caption and its hashtags; no match goes to fallback. min_row: a row with fewer Reels merges into fallback. manual: {media ID: row key}, always wins. A new niche is a new entry here plus its title in i18n, no code change.

rows.about: real estate: apartments, homes, residential projects, property developers, neighbourhoods
